about.title: About Us
about.p1: ShelfShot AI is a platform that lets store and product owners turn ordinary product photos into professional, studio-quality marketing shots using the latest AI models — without needing a photo studio or a professional designer.
about.p2: We believe every small or medium business owner deserves marketing photos that compete with major brands, at an affordable cost and within seconds.
offerItems: Generate professional product photos from a single image.
Naturally embed your brand logo within the scene.
Flexible subscription plans for individuals and small-to-medium businesses.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: At ShelfShot AI, we're committed to protecting our users' privacy. This policy explains what data we collect, and how we use and protect it.

sections.heading: 1. Data We Collect
items: Account data: email and password (encrypted) upon registration.
Uploaded images: product and logo images the user uploads for generation purposes.
Usage data: number of images generated, usage dates, and subscribed plan.
Payment data: fully processed through our approved third-party payment gateway; card numbers are never stored on our servers.

sections.heading: 2. How We Use Your Data
items: To provide the core service: generating images and keeping usage history.
To contact you about your account (email confirmation, password reset, important notices).
We do not sell your personal data to any third party for marketing purposes.

sections.heading: 3. Sharing Data with Third Parties
paragraphs: We use a number of trusted service providers to run the platform, and limited data is shared with them only to the extent needed to deliver the service:
items: Database and authentication provider (Supabase) for storing account data.
AI model provider (Google Gemini) for processing images and generating results.
Our approved payment gateway for processing subscriptions.
Email service provider for sending account notifications.

sections.heading: 4. Data Security
paragraphs: All data is transmitted over an encrypted connection (HTTPS/SSL). Access keys to external systems are stored on the server only and are never exposed to the browser.

sections.heading: 5. Your Rights
paragraphs: You may at any time request to view your data, correct it, or delete your account and all associated data, by contacting us via our

sections.heading: 6. Data Retention
paragraphs: We retain your account data and generated image history as long as your account is active. Upon account deletion, associated data is removed within a reasonable period, except where retention is required for accounting or legal purposes.

terms.title: Terms of Use
terms.intro: By using the ShelfShot AI website and service (the "Service"), you agree to the following terms and conditions. Please read them carefully before using the Service.

sections.heading: 1. Nature of the Service
paragraphs: ShelfShot AI is a monthly subscription-based service that allows users to upload their product photos and generate professional marketing images using AI models. The service is entirely digital and does not include any physical product shipped to the user.

sections.heading: 2. Accounts and Usage
items: You must be 18 years of age or older to create an account and use the Service.
You are responsible for keeping your login credentials confidential, and for any activity conducted through your account.
Using the Service to generate illegal content, content that infringes third-party intellectual property, offensive content, or content that violates applicable regulations is prohibited.

sections.heading: 3. Plans and Subscriptions
paragraphs: The Service is offered through monthly subscription plans with defined usage limits per plan (number of images generated monthly), as shown on the pricing page. The subscription renews automatically each month unless cancelled by the user before the renewal date.

sections.heading: 4. Intellectual Property of Generated Content
paragraphs: The user retains rights to the images they upload. Images resulting from the AI generation process may be used commercially by the user within the limits of their subscribed plan, with the understanding that AI models may produce results of varying quality, and ShelfShot AI does not guarantee the accuracy or suitability of every result for every use case.

sections.heading: 5. Limitation of Liability
paragraphs: The Service is provided "as is" without any express or implied warranties. ShelfShot AI is not liable for any indirect or consequential damages arising from the use of, or inability to use, the Service.

sections.heading: 6. Changes to These Terms
paragraphs: We reserve the right to modify these terms at any time. Any changes will be posted on this page, and your continued use of the Service after such changes constitutes implicit acceptance of them.

sections.heading: 7. Contact
paragraphs: For any inquiry regarding these terms, you can reach us via our

sections.heading: 1. Cancelling Your Subscription
paragraphs: You can cancel your subscription at any time from the dashboard, with no extra fees or minimum commitment. Upon cancellation, your access to the current plan continues until the end of the paid period, and the subscription will not renew automatically afterward.

sections.heading: 2. Refund Policy
paragraphs: Since the service is digital and consumed immediately upon subscribing (image generation incurs an actual processing cost as soon as it's requested), we do not offer refunds for amounts paid for the current subscription period once any portion of the monthly image quota has been used.

If you experience a technical issue that prevented you from using the service fully during the month (due to a fault on our end), please contact us within 7 days of the issue occurring, and we will review the case and provide appropriate compensation (subscription extension or partial refund) depending on the nature of the issue.

sections.heading: 3. Incorrect or Duplicate Payments
paragraphs: If a duplicate or incorrect charge occurs for any technical reason, please contact us immediately via our
sections.paragraphSuffix: with proof of payment attached, and the excess amount will be refunded within 5-10 business days.

sections.heading: 4. Changing Your Plan
paragraphs: You can upgrade to a higher plan at any time, and the difference will be prorated. To move to a lower plan, the change takes effect starting from the next billing cycle.

sections.heading: 5. Supported Payment Methods
paragraphs: We accept payment via Visa and Mastercard, in addition to digital payment wallets supported by our approved payment gateway.

sections.heading: 6. Delivery Policy
paragraphs: ShelfShot AI is a fully digital service and does not involve any physical shipping or delivery. As soon as generation is complete, the result appears directly inside your account dashboard, and you can download it immediately with no waiting or additional fees.
